parameterdescription.para: Address of the eFuse BISR tag word
Number of repair-data words following the tag

briefdescription.para: Run the CPM6 GTMPW NPI BISR memory repair sequence.

parameterdescription.para: Address of the eFuse BISR tag word
Number of repair-data words following the tag
Upper 16 bits of the GTMPW NPI module base address
Returns the eFuse address following the repair data
